releases.name: Black Gold: Oil Drilling Simulator
releases.summary:
Black Gold is a first person management simulator game where you take your place in the race for money.

You are the one responsible for your success: decide who work for you, choose where you put your first steps and control how well your oil wells run.

After you sell your first crude oil barrel, your wallet will grow quickly. Spend money to discover new technology, enlarge your workplace, buy new machines or upgrade them.

releases.name: The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline
releases.summary: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

releases.name: The Crust
releases.summary:
The Crust is a game in which you are given the role of CEO of a giant lunar colonization company. It is a large-scale economic simulation game in which you have to find a balance between survival and development, managing the infrastructure, resources and team.

Mine valuable resources, automate production, manage scientific expeditions, and explore the lunar surface. 

400,000 kilometers away from Earth, you will see just how vast the cosmos really is, and how little we yet know about its mysteries. Get ready to face some tough choices- after all, the future of mankind may depend on your decisions...

releases.name: Total Futsal Manager
releases.summary: Take control of a futsal club and build your career season after season. Manage your squad, transfers, contracts, training, tactics, finances, and dressing room as you compete to take your team all the way to the top.

releases.name: Dumb Ways to Build
releases.summary:
Dumb Ways to Build is a physics-based co-op game filled with deadly construction jobs that no sane crew would touch. Safety violations are likely, survival is optional, and your co-workers are the real occupational hazard. It is time to rally your crew and put your building skills (and friendships) to the ultimate test!

Grab, rotate, and throw anything not bolted down to use as makeshift building materials. Fire your trusty nail gun to staple together sketchy bridges, ramps, and structures. You and your crew must work together to build your own platforms, solve deadly challenges and escape the jobsite.

releases.name: Wardstone
releases.summary: You are gonna be space hero. Your mission is to save Queen D from the aliens. Help her by using right arrow to go right and left arrow for the left. Push the button left to get speed and right button to fire so you can kill the enemies. Watch out, prevent hitting the meteorites. When you see F and P barrrels, collect them. F is your fuel and P is your power shield which will protect you. You have three lives in every level. Don't count on that, life is valuable don't spend your lives in vain whenever you hit a spaceship or the meteorites you will lose one. Enjoy it.

releases.name: La eclissi
releases.summary: A fascinating strategy puzzle of its own kind! ? The idea is pretty simple: Find the paths connecting houses of the same color. You strategy a direction between two homes and build the best way by moving the different flooring. By considering forward you can find the best way with the least goes and in the least time. ? With Pixopush 3 there are about 450 different games of varying difficulty waiting for you - in three main categories: "training", "simple" and "tricky".? In case you cannot solve a tricky puzzle, you can display a possible solution while playing.? Challenge your friends and the rest of the world through Game Center.

releases.name: Zumba - Magical Marble Saga
releases.summary: Hero Gladiator is a very interesting cartoon style RPG game. Player in the magic world play a four team challenge evil. Experience of brutal fighting, to win the final victory. Hero Gladiator not only requires a single team member equipment upgrade, but also the pursuit of team cooperation. The combination of rational team, the appropriate use of various skills will enhance the combat effectiveness of the team.Features:8 different occupation, flexible combination of team.120 occupation skill, rich combat tactics.50 levels, fully and delightfully battle.7 powerful boss, kill them to get huge rewards.How to play:At the beginning of game, player has "knight" and "priest" two team member. You can hire heros like "magician", "Barbarian", "CrazyWarrior", "Assassin", "Amazon", "Nun" occupation, and player also can buy or upgrade equipments, learn new skill, and so on.Any suggestions and questions, please send mail to fireflygame@163.com, we are looking forward to your letter.

releases.name: DOGEZA
releases.summary: A first-person Japanese horror game set in a cursed castle. As a lord with fading memories, explore the grounds at night, uncover the regrets of the dead, and atone the only way you can — by performing DOGEZA, the deepest bow of apology. Three endings await.

releases.name: Dirt Fishing: Metal Detecting Simulator
releases.summary: Play as Ethan, by exploring forests, beaches, and deserts with a metal detector to find junk, gold, silver, coins, and relics. Sell finds to upgrade gear, collect U.S. coins, climb leaderboards, and fulfill your grandfather's challenge—collect 100 relics to become a Legendary Treasure Hunter.
